description: This file defines a static utility class 'JNode' for working with JSON nodes, including loading, parsing, cloning, converting, and querying JSON data using JSONPath. It provides methods for serialization, deserialization, and path normalization, tailored for the OrchardCore project.

classes.name: JNode
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for JSON node operations such as loading, parsing, cloning, converting, path normalization, and querying using JSONPath.

methods.name: LoadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a JSON node from a stream with optional node and document options.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a JSON node from a Utf8JsonReader reference with optional node options.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonNode with optional node and document options.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JSON string into a JsonNode, returning success status.

methods.name: FromObject
methods.description: Creates a JsonNode from an object, handling JsonNode, JsonElement, or serializable objects.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of a JsonNode.

methods.name: ToObject
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonNode into a specified type.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a JsonNode as a specified type.

methods.name: ValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a JsonNode as a specified type or returns a default.

methods.name: GetNormalizedPath
methods.description: Returns the JSONPath with the root '$' skipped.

methods.name: SelectNode
methods.description: Selects a JsonNode from a JsonObject using a JSONPath expression.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges content into a JsonNode using JsonMergeSettings.
